basic_info.description: A rare opportunity to own this incredible full-floor Penthouse Unit with sweeping VIEWS of the Bay and Downtown. Including private *Pano-View Roof Deck, legal *1-Bed ADU and oversized *Private Garage.  Designed for modern living, the open floor plan is flooded with natural light capturing incredible views from multiple rooms. Highlights include state-of -the-art features, modern appliances, radiant heat, on-demand water, in-unit laundry and gas fireplace. Stairs or elevator open to a private deck overlooking the Bay and Coit Tower. Beautiful shared garden with mature landscape and bike storage area. *BONUS* The property includes a legal, remodeled ADU; perfect for home office, rental income, additional living space etc..  A++ Location, close to world-class North Beach restaurants and shops, Jackson Square, Downtown and the Embarcadero waterfront. WalkScore of 99!
